info.title: v2.principal.get_principal_sales_performance_detail
info.description: Queries the business performance data aggregated at principal level for the specified regions within the selected time range. Supports request granularity by day, week, month, quarter, year, or customize, and returns both overall summary metrics and region-level detailed metrics.

post.description: Queries the business performance data aggregated at principal level for the specified regions within the selected time range. Supports request granularity by day, week, month, quarter, year, or customize, and returns both overall summary metrics and region-level detailed metrics.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency used for amount-based metrics for the region. Limitations: - Optional for every region object in region_list. - Supported values are LOCAL and USD. - Invalid currency values are rejected as invalid_parameter. - Defaults to USD when omitted.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date of the requested period in YYYY-MM-DD format. Limitations: - Must use the YYYY-MM-DD format. - Must be a valid calendar date. - Must not be earlier than start_date. - Validation is based on the requested timezone. - For customize, end_date must not be later than the day before the current day in the requested timezone. The inclusive date range from start_date to end_date must not exceed 366 days. - For day, end_date must equal start_date. - For week, end_date must be within the selected week range: from start_date (Sunday) to the end of that Sunday-to-Saturday week, or to the latest selectable day if the week extends beyond today. Formally: startDate ≤ endDate ≤ min(startDate + 6 days, today - 1 day). - For month, end_date must be within the selected month: from the 1st day of the month to the last calendar day of that month, or to the latest selectable day for the current month. Formally: startDate ≤ endDate ≤ min(month end, today - 1 day). - For quarter, end_date must be within the selected quarter: from the 1st day of the quarter to the last calendar day of that quarter, or to the latest selectable day for the current quarter. Formally: startDate ≤ endDate ≤ min(quarter end, today - 1 day). - For year, end_date must be within the selected year: from January 1st to December 31st of that year, or to the latest selectable day for the current year. Formally: startDate ≤ endDate ≤ min(Dec 31, today - 1 day).

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Aggregation granularity that determines the validation rules for the requested date range and the reporting period. Limitations: - Supported values are customize, day, week, month, quarter, and year. - customize is validated as a free date range and is internally queried as daily data. - day represents a single calendar day. - week requires a Sunday-based calendar week. - month requires a calendar month range. - quarter requires a calendar quarter range. - year requires a calendar year range. - Any other value is rejected as invalid_parameter.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: principal_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a principal.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Target region code of the principal to be queried. Limitations: - Required for every region object in region_list. - Must be a valid region code or region name recognized by the API, such as SG or ID.

parameters.name: region_list
parameters.description: List of principal regions to be queried. Limitations: - Optional. If omitted or empty, the API queries all regions that belong to the specified principal. - Duplicate region entries are deduplicated internally. - The same region must not appear multiple times with different currency values.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by(depends on different APIs) partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, principal_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date of the requested period in YYYY-MM-DD format. Limitations: - Must use the YYYY-MM-DD format. - Must be a valid calendar date. - Must not be later than end_date. - Validation is based on the requested timezone. - The earliest selectable date is calculated as: current day in timezone - 1 day - 2 years. - The exact boundary rules depend on granularity: -- For customize, start_date must not be earlier than the earliest selectable date. -- For day, start_date must equal end_date. -- For week, start_date must be a Sunday. -- For month, start_date must be the first day of the month. -- For quarter, start_date must be the first day of the quarter. -- For year, start_date must be the first day of the year.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: Timezone used for date boundary calculation, selectable date validation, and timestamp conversion. Limitations: - Enum values: [\"GMT+7\", \"GMT+8\", \"GMT-3\"] - All date validation rules are evaluated in the requested timezone.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/principal/get_principal_sales_performance_detail?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&principal_id=principal_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "end_date": "2026-01-01",
    "granularity": "day",
    "region_list": [
        {
            "currency": "USD",
            "region": "MY"
        }
    ],
    "start_date": "2026-01-01",
    "timezone": "GMT+8"
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

x-shopee-error-codes.Details and Guidance: 1. timezone field is missing from the request body - Cause: The JSON body of the POST request completely lacks the timezone field - Fix: Add the "timezone" field to the request body using one of the allowed timezone values: "GMT+7", "GMT+8", "GMT-3", for example {"start_date": "2024-01-15", "end_date": "2024-01-31", "timezone": "GMT+8", ...} 2. timezone value is empty or blank - Cause: The timezone field value is an empty string "" or contains only whitespace " ", the @NotBlank validation detects this - Fix: Provide a valid timezone value, must be selected from the allowed list: "GMT+7", "GMT+8", "GMT-3", cannot be empty 3. timezone value is null - Cause: timezone is explicitly set to null - Fix: Provide a valid timezone value selected from the allowed list: "GMT+7", "GMT+8", "GMT-3" 4. timezone key name is misspelled - Cause: Using a different key name, such as "timeZone" (camelCase) or "time_zone", etc. - Fix: Use the correct key name "timezone" (all lowercase, no underscores) Show more

x-shopee-error-codes.Error Description: timezone is invalid. allowed values: GMT+7, GMT+8, GMT-3.
x-shopee-error-codes.Details and Guidance: 1.timezone value is not in the allowed list - Cause: The provided timezone value is not in the allowed timezone list (such as "Asia/Shanghai", "UTC", "GMT+5", etc.) - Fix: Only the following allowed timezone values are supported: "GMT+7", "GMT+8", "GMT-3" Show more

1. granularity field is missing from the request body - Cause: The JSON body of the POST request completely lacks the granularity field - Fix: Add the "granularity" field to the request body using one of the allowed granularity values: "day", "week", "month", "quarter", "year", "customize", for example {"start_date": "2024-01-15", "end_date": "2024-01-31", "granularity": "day", ...} 2. granularity value is empty or blank - Cause: The granularity field value is an empty string "" or contains only whitespace " ", the @NotBlank validation detects this - Fix: Provide a valid granularity value, must be selected from the allowed list: "day", "week", "month", "quarter", "year", "customize", cannot be empty 3. granularity value is null - Cause: granularity is explicitly set to null - Fix: Provide a valid granularity value selected from the allowed list: "day", "week", "month", "quarter", "year", "customize" 4. granularity key name is misspelled - Cause: Using a different key name, such as "Granularity" or "grain_ularity" or "time_granularity", etc. - Fix: Use the correct key name "granularity" (all lowercase, no underscores) 5. granularity value is not in the allowed list - Cause: The provided granularity value is not in the allowed granularity list (such as "DAILY", "Daily", "hours", etc.) - Fix: Only the following allowed granularity values are supported (case-insensitive, but lowercase is recommended): - "day" - daily aggregation - "week" - weekly aggregation (starting on Sunday) - "month" - monthly aggregation - "quarter" - quarterly aggregation - "year" - yearly aggregation - "customize" - custom date range Show more
1. request body JSON format is invalid - Cause: The JSON sent is incorrectly formatted, such as missing quotes, commas, mismatched brackets, etc. - Fix: Check if the JSON format is valid. Show more

1. currency value is not in the allowed list - Cause: The currency field value in a shop object in shop_list is not an allowed currency type, system throws exception when calling CurrencyEnum.valueOf() - Fix: currency supports only two values (case-insensitive): "usd" or "local". For example {"shop_id": 123456, "currency": "usd"} or {"shop_id": 123456, "currency": "local"} Show more

1. a region value in region_list does not match any allowed region - Cause: The region field value in a region object in region_list does not match any allowed region (comparison is case-insensitive) - Fix: region supports only the following values (case-insensitive): "id", "my", "th", "tw", "sg", "ph", "vn", "br". For example {"region": "sg", "currency": "usd"} Show more

1. an element in region_list is missing the region field - Cause: A region object in the region_list array does not have the region field - Fix: Ensure each object in region_list contains the region field, format: {"region": "sg", "currency": "usd"} 2. region value is null - Cause: region is explicitly set to null, the @NotNull validation detects this - Fix: Provide a valid region value for each region, region must be one of the allowed region codes: "id", "my", "th", "tw", "sg", "ph", "vn", "br" Show more

x-shopee-error-codes.Details and Guidance: 1. the data corresponding to the requested end_date is still being processed and has not completed - Cause: The dashboard data update on the data platform has a delay (usually T-1 or T-2). The data corresponding to the end_date of the current request is still being processed. - Fix: Retry the request later. Show more

x-shopee-error-codes.Details and Guidance: 1. start_date and end_date are not the same when using day granularity - Cause: When granularity is "day", the system requires querying data for a single date, therefore start_date and end_date must be the same - Fix: Set start_date and end_date to the same date. For example, if you want to query daily data for 2024-01-15, set "start_date": "2024-01-15" and "end_date": "2024-01-15" Show more

1. request is from an unauthorized gateway - Cause: The request is not forwarded from the open platform but sent directly from an unauthorized source - Fix: Ensure all API requests are forwarded through the open platform, do not call the API directly Show more

1. start_date field is missing from the request body - Cause: The JSON body of the POST request completely lacks the start_date field - Fix: Add "start_date": "YYYY-MM-DD" to the request body, for example {"start_date": "2024-01-15", "end_date": "2024-01-31", ...} 2. start_date value is empty or blank - Cause: The start_date field value is an empty string "" or contains only whitespace " " - Fix: Provide an actual date value in YYYY-MM-DD format, cannot be empty 3. start_date value is null - Cause: start_date is explicitly set to null - Fix: Provide a valid date value in YYYY-MM-DD format 4. start_date key name is misspelled - Cause: Using a different key name, such as "startDate" (camelCase) or "start_Date", etc. - Fix: Use the correct key name "start_date" (lowercase with underscores) Show more

x-shopee-error-codes.Error Description: start_date is required; start_date must use YYYY-MM-DD
x-shopee-error-codes.Details and Guidance: 1.start_date date format is incorrect - Cause: The date format is not YYYY-MM-DD, such as "2024/01/15" or "01-15-2024" or "2024-1-15" - Fix: Use the standard format YYYY-MM-DD, ensure both month and day are two digits, for example "2024-01-15" (not "2024-1-15") Show more

1. end_date field is missing from the request body - Cause: The JSON body of the POST request completely lacks the end_date field - Fix: Add "end_date": "YYYY-MM-DD" to the request body, for example {"start_date": "2024-01-15", "end_date": "2024-01-31", ...} 2. end_date value is empty or blank - Cause: The end_date field value is an empty string "" or contains only whitespace " " - Fix: Provide an actual date value in YYYY-MM-DD format, cannot be empty 3. end_date value is null - Cause: end_date is explicitly set to null - Fix: Provide a valid date value in YYYY-MM-DD format 4. end_date key name is misspelled - Cause: Using a different key name, such as "endDate" (camelCase) or "end_Date", etc. - Fix: Use the correct key name "end_date" (lowercase with underscores) Show more

1.end_date date format is incorrect - Cause: The date format is not YYYY-MM-DD, such as "2024/01/31" or "01-31-2024" or "2024-1-31" - Fix: Use the standard format YYYY-MM-DD, ensure both month and day are two digits, for example "2024-01-31" (not "2024-1-31") Show more
